All US wildfires, acres burned per year (NIFC)

Map: Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS), U.S. Geological Survey and USDA Forest Service, "Fire Occurrence Dataset (FOD) Point Locations from 1984–2026" (published 22 November 2026): wildfires only (prescribed burns left out), placed at the centre of their burned area, sized by burned-area acres. MTBS maps all fires larger than 1,000 acres in the western US and 500 acres in the eastern US; 2025 and later are not yet complete, so the map ends in 2024. Puerto Rico is not shown. Heatmap: MTBS Burned Areas Boundaries 1984–2026 (published 22 November 2026), the mapped perimeter of each of the same wildfires, filled into pixels of 0.1° of latitude by 0.1° of longitude (0.2° in Alaska), about 10 km; each pixel adds up the acres that burned inside it, so land that burned more than once counts each time. Chart: National Interagency Fire Center, total wildland fires and acres, 1983–2025, all fire sizes (source: National Interagency Coordination Center). 2004 does not include state lands for North Carolina; there is no official data before 1983. · Highcharts.com
